Welcome

Swing Dance Kobe is all about spreading the fun of Swing Dancing, in the Kobe area here in Japan. We act in the spirit of Frankie Manning to make this dance available to as many people as possible. Why, because it brings so much fun in your life! Be part of our community.

We organise social events, participate in festivals and also provide dance lessons. We all help each other out. We embrace the craziness of swing. We encourage people to be different. Dancing makes us happy, this is scientifically proven!

SWING DANCE KOBE

Good music. Good company. See you on the floor.
